scope: Permutation-calibrated DESI DR1 BGS luminosity-rank octupole consistency test (ell=3). No physical wake template is fitted to the octupole.
primary_observational_inference: The reported five-tracer DESI dipole coefficient uses 256 luminosity-mark permutations: A_wake = -0.0768409 +/- 0.0851660, empirical two-sided p = 0.37354. This octupole control uses its recorded 32-permutation reference vector.
decision_rule: empirical p >= 0.05: consistent with null; empirical p < 0.05: investigate survey/estimator systematics before any physical interpretation

covariance_condition_number_definition.raw_covariance: Standard delete-one jackknife covariance C_JK from 30 regions.
covariance_condition_number_definition.regularization: C_reg = C_JK + r I, with r = max(1e-7 * lambda_max(C_JK), 1e-6 * median(diag(C_JK)), 1e-14).
covariance_condition_number_definition.reported_condition_number: np.linalg.cond(C_reg), i.e. the condition number of the ridge-regularized covariance used in the Mahalanobis inverse.
covariance_condition_number_definition.note: The raw covariance is full rank (18/18), but its condition number was not separately reported by this run.

analysis_role: Higher odd-multipole null control; not a second estimate of the wake amplitude.
analysis_scope: The octupole and the 32-permutation reference dipole use the same tracer sample and sampled pair geometry. The subsequent 256-permutation dipole calibration has a different permutation-null mean.
